# `Q-13-2` — Navbar references missing document

> A navbar entry points at a document that is not in the
> project's render index.

## What this means

The website navbar (the top bar of links rendered above every
page) is built from `website.navbar` entries in `_quarto.yml`.
Each entry that names a document is looked up in the project
index at render time. This error fires when the name does not
appear in that index. The navbar still renders, but the entry
has no working link.

## Why this happens

Same family of causes as `Q-13-1` (sidebar missing document):
typo in the navbar entry, renamed or deleted document,
excluded-from-render file, wrong relative-path base.

## How to fix

Update the navbar entry to point at a file that is in the
render set, or add the missing file. The message names the
missing path.

## Related

- `Q-13-1`, `Q-13-3`, `Q-13-4`, `Q-13-7` — same shape of
  diagnostic for sidebar, page footer, body link, and
  page-navigation surfaces respectively.
